motive.zhHans: 他之所以选在半夜的隧道里动手，是因为不想让下车的人看见挂在窗外的尸体。Kaetsu 脱离了团伙，打算同时向两个人复仇：逼迫他女友过量吸毒的 Asuma，以及向他女友出售毒品的 Izumo。
motive.en: He chose to operate in the tunnel in the middle of the night because he didn't want people off the train to see the corpse hanging off. Kaetsu left the gang and planned to avenge both Asuma for forcing his girlfriend to over consume drugs and Izumo for selling his girlfriend drugs.

method.zhHans: 优作及时现身，向这位曾崇拜他作品的犯人揭示了手法与自己的身份。Kaetsu 化装成 Asama，用他的钓鱼装备让人以为 Asama 跳下了火车。他先将 Asama 击中头部致死，再用装了消音器的枪打碎车窗。接着，他把钓鱼线穿过对方裤子后侧的皮带环，将人吊在窗外。他把钓鱼线的一端系在滑轮上，另一端系在屋外固定物上。最后，他又用另一根钓鱼线，一端做成环，穿上一片胶带。他用这套手法把 Izumo 被杀的罪名栽到 Asama 头上。犯人作案时穿的那件衬衫，在他的行李里和化装衣物一起被找到了。
method.en: Yusaku appears just in time and reveals the trick and his own identity to the criminal, who had idolized his work. Kaetsu dressed like Asama and made people believe that he jump off the train by using his fishing equipment. First, he hit Asama in the head until he died and broke the window using silenced gun. Then, he put the fishing line through the belt loop on the back of his pants and hung him outside the window. He tied the side of the fishing line to the pulley and the other to something stable outside the room. Lastly, he used another fishing line, looped one end, and put a piece of tape through it. He used this trick to framed Asama on the murder of Izumo. The shirt the criminal used is found on his luggage together with the disguise outfit.

evidence.zhHans: 犯人作案时穿的那件衬衫，在他的行李里和化装衣物一起被找到了。这就是他确实是犯人的证据。Kaetsu 承认了这两起杀人，并供称自己是模仿了他所喜爱的一位名小说家的未发表作品。
evidence.en: The shirt the criminal used is found on his luggage together with the disguise outfit. This is the evidence that he is really the culprit. Kaetsu admitted the two murders and revealed he imitated the unpublished novel of a famous novelist that he likes.

resolution.zhHans: 然而，当列车抵达札幌站时，柯南与有希子被分开了，犯人趁机动手，企图把她推下轨道。杀人未遂。地点：北海道札幌市中央区札幌站。
resolution.en: When the train lands at Sapporo Station, however, Conan and Yukiko are separated and the criminal moves, intending to push her onto the tracks. Attempted murder Location: Sapporo Station Chūō-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido
